items.correct: Many groups — homesteaders, miners, ranchers and railroad workers — while Native peoples were displaced.
items.why: The West's history involves diverse settlers and the dispossession of Native Americans.

items.q: Was the American West 'empty land' free for the taking?
items.correct: No — it was home to many Native American nations long before settlers arrived.
items.why: Settlement displaced established Native societies through treaties that were often broken.
